units.id: phrase:friendly civilian|I just found out that a "duck" is a type of bird from Earth! Now I wonder why "duck tape" is named after it?|2587|0
units.english: I just found out that a "duck" is a type of bird from Earth! Now I wonder why "duck tape" is named after it?
units.italian: Ho appena scoperto che un "duck" è un tipo di uccello della Terra! Ora mi chiedo perché il "duck tape" prenda il nome da lui?

units.id: phrase:friendly civilian|Apparently they want me to pay 5% of my paycheck for union dues! I'm gonna keep it. My boss is a good guy; he'll look out for me.|2588|0
units.english: Apparently they want me to pay 5% of my paycheck for union dues! I'm gonna keep it. My boss is a good guy; he'll look out for me.
units.italian: A quanto pare vogliono che paghi il 5% del mio stipendio per la quota sindacale! Me lo tengo. Il mio capo è una brava persona; penserà lui a me.

units.id: phrase:friendly civilian|I saved up and bought extra bunk space so my wife could come on trips with me, and now she says "we need to talk." That can't be a good sign, can it?|2589|0
units.english: I saved up and bought extra bunk space so my wife could come on trips with me, and now she says "we need to talk." That can't be a good sign, can it?
units.italian: Ho risparmiato e comprato cuccette in più perché mia moglie potesse venire in viaggio con me, e ora dice "dobbiamo parlare". Non è un buon segno, vero?

units.id: phrase:friendly civilian|I bumped into some nasty pirates last week. I had to dump my cargo to get away, and my insurance is not paying me back.|2590|0
units.english: I bumped into some nasty pirates last week. I had to dump my cargo to get away, and my insurance is not paying me back.
units.italian: La settimana scorsa ho incrociato dei pirati poco simpatici. Ho dovuto gettare il carico per fuggire, e l'assicurazione non mi rimborsa.

units.id: phrase:friendly civilian|If you are in a tight spot with some pirates, just throw everything out the airlock. They will be busy scavenging it, and you will be out of reach when they inevitably come back.|2591|0
units.english: If you are in a tight spot with some pirates, just throw everything out the airlock. They will be busy scavenging it, and you will be out of reach when they inevitably come back.
units.italian: Se sei nei guai con dei pirati, butta tutto fuori dal portello. Saranno occupati a recuperarlo, e tu sarai fuori portata quando torneranno, come inevitabilmente faranno.

units.id: phrase:friendly civilian|When I was hauling food in the South I ran into pirates every damn week. Half the time I had to bribe them with my salary or with a part of my freight.|2592|0
units.english: When I was hauling food in the South I ran into pirates every damn week. Half the time I had to bribe them with my salary or with a part of my freight.
units.italian: Quando trasportavo cibo nel Sud incrociavo pirati ogni benedetta settimana. Metà delle volte dovevo corromperli con lo stipendio o con una parte del carico.

units.id: phrase:friendly civilian|My friend was boarded by pirates and they took his engines. It would have been cheaper to just let them have the cargo.|2593|0
units.english: My friend was boarded by pirates and they took his engines. It would have been cheaper to just let them have the cargo.
units.italian: Il mio amico è stato abbordato dai pirati e gli hanno preso i motori. Gli sarebbe costato meno lasciargli il carico.

units.id: phrase:friendly civilian|You can often distract pirates with some cargo until the Navy rescues you. My old captain taught me this trick when we were ferrying in the Far North.|2594|0
units.english: You can often distract pirates with some cargo until the Navy rescues you. My old captain taught me this trick when we were ferrying in the Far North.
units.italian: Spesso puoi distrarre i pirati con un po' di carico finché la Marina non ti salva. Il mio vecchio capitano me l'ha insegnato quando facevamo la spola nell'estremo Nord.

units.id: phrase:friendly civilian|Pirates will always try to take your cargo, but if you drop some scrap their way, they let you keep the real valuables.|2595|0
units.english: Pirates will always try to take your cargo, but if you drop some scrap their way, they let you keep the real valuables.
units.italian: I pirati proveranno sempre a prenderti il carico, ma se gli lasci un po' di rottami ti lasciano tenere gli oggetti di valore veri.

units.id: phrase:friendly civilian|Whenever I see pirates, I immediately dump my freight. They would get it either way, but at least this lets me get away.|2596|0
units.english: Whenever I see pirates, I immediately dump my freight. They would get it either way, but at least this lets me get away.
units.italian: Ogni volta che vedo dei pirati getto subito il carico. Tanto se lo prenderebbero comunque, ma almeno così riesco a fuggire.
